name: Calculate Brain Adc Map
description: Calculate Apparent Diffusion Coefficient (ADC) map from diffusion-weighted MRI data using monoexponential diffusion model.
detailed_description: Calculate Apparent Diffusion Coefficient (ADC) map from diffusion-weighted MRI data using monoexponential diffusion model.
when_to_use: When you need calculate brain adc map analysis

parameters.dwi_file_path: [Required] Path to the 4D NIfTI file containing diffusion-weighted MRI data (str)
parameters.b_values: [Required] List of b-values corresponding to each volume in the 4D DWI data (List[float])
parameters.output_path: [Optional] Path where the output ADC map will be saved (default: adc_map.nii.gz)
parameters.mask_file_path: [Optional] Path to a binary mask file to limit ADC calculation to brain regions
